name: Banking & Finance
shortDescription: Comprehensive legal solutions for financial transactions.
description: Our Banking & Finance practice advises lenders, borrowers, and financial institutions on complex financing transactions. We have deep expertise in project finance, acquisition finance, debt restructuring, and regulatory compliance. Our team stays current with evolving RBI regulations and market practices.

faqs.question: What is involved in loan documentation?
faqs.answer: Loan documentation includes facility agreements, security documents (mortgages, pledges, guarantees), intercreditor agreements, and conditions precedent. We draft and negotiate documentation that protects lender interests while meeting borrower requirements.

faqs.question: How can you help with debt restructuring?
faqs.answer: We advise on one-time settlements, debt-equity conversions, tenure extensions, and IBC proceedings. We negotiate with lenders, draft restructuring documentation, and help implement approved resolution plans.

faqs.question: What regulations apply to fintech companies?
faqs.answer: Fintech companies must navigate RBI guidelines on digital lending, payment systems, and NBFCs. We help with licensing, compliance frameworks, and structuring arrangements to operate within regulatory boundaries.
